rationale.overall: B reproduces the reference's translucent curled band with real volume and a legible opening, while A collapses the same element into a flat, opaque disc, so B is the closer match overall despite the two takes sharing an identical block.
rationale.material: B's curl carries continuous gradient shading across a cylindrical surface with a shaded interior wall, echoing the reference's translucent ribbon, whereas A's curl is a hard two-tone cutout with a pasted-on stripe texture and no light falloff.
rationale.silhouette: B's outline reads as a looped band with a visible elliptical mouth and a tail running into the block, matching the reference's read; A's outline reads as a solid comma or numeral blob whose relationship to the block is unclear.
rationale.smallsize: At 32px and 16px both takes are dominated by the identical dark bar and its orange underglow, and the curl reduces to a low-contrast light smudge in each, so neither holds up better when shrunk.
